page.overview:
Who is Arnulf Pavian?

Arnulf Pavian was the Imperial general in lead of the Stirland army during the Chaos invasion of Kislev during the Storm of Chaos. This was until his assassination in the Winter Palace by a rat-headed assasin.

He fought alongside the Tilean mercenary general Albertalli at Krasicyno against the Kurgan.
